- scrape_contact_details: This API is really helpful if you want to extract emails or phone numbers from any website without any challenges or coding issues.
- send_branded_sms_to_multiple_numbers: Branded SMS Pakistan provide Mask or Short Code Messaging Gateway in Pakistan. This API is useful to send a branded sms to multiple numbers

I need to contact Mark Henderson regarding a personal matter; please search for his record using the ca-orange source ID and send him a text message saying 'Please call me back to discuss the unresolved matter from last week'.
